trophies.guide:
1. Earn the other 54 trophies in any order — the platinum pops on its own when the last one lands. [1][2]
2. If it has not popped, filter this tracker to Unearned and clear the shortest stage first. [1][5]
3. The longest road is the 100% checklist (trophy #14); everything else is shorter. [1][10]
4. Keep one manual save per chapter start and end — ten saves of your fifteen slots — so nothing can lock you out. [1][25]
5. Cheats stay off the whole run: they switch off trophies and saving. [1][23]

intro.text: The platinum pops on its own the moment the last of the other 54 lands — there is nothing extra to do for it.
No multiplayer, no DLC and no difficulty setting stand between you and it; one playthrough is enough.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order — the platinum pops on its own when the last one lands.
If it has not popped, filter this tracker to Unearned and clear the shortest stage first.
The longest road is the 100% checklist (trophy #14); everything else is shorter.
Keep one manual save per chapter start and end — ten saves of your fifteen slots — so nothing can lock you out.
Cheats stay off the whole run: they switch off trophies and saving.

tips.text: Plan for 200 to 250 hours in total; the story is 60 to 80 and the 100% grind is the rest.

trophies.description: Complete the first main mission, 'Gone Fishing'.
trophies.guide:
1. Start Chapter 1 and play the first main mission, 'Gone Fishing'. [1][5]
2. Finish the mission — the trophy pops at the end, automatically. [1][5]
3. Nothing here can be missed: story trophies pop from the mission itself. [1][3]
4. It unlocks the rest of Chapter 1's missions and the free-roam map around them. [1][25]
5. Check it in the trophy list if it does not show — it is listed as earned once the mission ends. [5]

intro.text: The first trophy of the run — it pops at the end of Chapter 1's opening mission.
Story trophies are automatic: play the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Start Chapter 1 and play the first main mission, 'Gone Fishing'.
Finish the mission — the trophy pops at the end, automatically.
Nothing here can be missed: story trophies pop from the mission itself.
It unlocks the rest of Chapter 1's missions and the free-roam map around them.
Check it in the trophy list if it does not show — it is listed as earned once the mission ends.

tips.text: Make your first manual save at the start of Chapter 1 — it protects the one possibly-missable trophy later.

trophies.guide:
1. Play through Chapter 1's main missions in order. [1][5]
2. Before the chapter ends, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (see #28) and keep a Chapter 1 save. [1][11]
3. Start the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?' — the trophy pops as Chapter 1 closes. [1][5]
4. It is automatic: no extra objective is needed. [1][3]
5. From here the side chains start appearing — Kenton's in Chapter 1, Cal's after 'Feng Shui'. [1][28]

intro.text: Chapter 1 ends when you start the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'.
Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for trophy #28 — it may not come back.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1's main missions in order.
Before the chapter ends, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (see #28) and keep a Chapter 1 save.
Start the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?' — the trophy pops as Chapter 1 closes.
It is automatic: no extra objective is needed.
From here the side chains start appearing — Kenton's in Chapter 1, Cal's after 'Feng Shui'.

tips.text: Do not rush out of Chapter 1: the balcony meditation is the only possibly-missable action in the game.

trophies.guide:
1. Play through Chapter 2's main missions in order. [1][5]
2. Complete the mission 'Breakfast Run' along the way — it carries its own trophy (#8). [1][5]
3. After 'Coffee Break', character switching opens and the partner feats become possible. [1][25]
4. Start the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City' — the trophy pops as Chapter 2 closes. [1][3]
5. It is automatic; nothing extra is needed. [1][5]

intro.text: Chapter 2 ends when the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City', begins.
Chapter 2 is where the partner system opens — free-roam together unlocks after 'Coffee Break'.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2's main missions in order.
Complete the mission 'Breakfast Run' along the way — it carries its own trophy (#8).
After 'Coffee Break', character switching opens and the partner feats become possible.
Start the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City' — the trophy pops as Chapter 2 closes.
It is automatic; nothing extra is needed.

tips.text: Buy the garages after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver' — the real-estate app installs then.

trophies.guide:
1. Play through Chapter 3's main missions in order. [1][5]
2. Complete 'The Cartel Heist' along the way — it carries its own trophy (#9). [1][5]
3. Do Yasmani's jewelry jobs when they appear; they unlock the Snap Gun and shop robberies. [1][34]
4. Finish the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life' — the trophy pops then. [1][5]
5. It is automatic; nothing extra is needed. [1][3]

intro.text: Chapter 3 ends after its first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.
Chapter 3 opens the Key Cloner, the fence Yasmani and the jewelry jobs.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3's main missions in order.
Complete 'The Cartel Heist' along the way — it carries its own trophy (#9).
Do Yasmani's jewelry jobs when they appear; they unlock the Snap Gun and shop robberies.
Finish the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life' — the trophy pops then.
It is automatic; nothing extra is needed.

tips.text: Start Randy's and Tyrone's chains in Chapter 3 — both are marked automatically.

trophies.guide:
1. Play through Chapter 4's main missions in order. [1][5]
2. Complete 'Child's Play', 'Headliners' and 'VCIA Takedown' along the way — each carries its own trophy. [1][5]
3. Do the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' when it is marked — it opens bank vault robberies. [1][20]
4. Complete the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero' — the trophy pops then. [1][5]
5. It is automatic; nothing extra is needed. [1][3]

intro.text: Chapter 4 ends with its final main mission, 'Starting From Zero'.
Chapter 4 holds three named-mission trophies of its own.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4's main missions in order.

Do the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' when it is marked — it opens bank vault robberies.

tips.text: Bank vaults open in Chapter 4 — five of them are needed for trophy #40.

trophies.guide:
1. Play the story through to its final mission. [1][5]
2. Complete the final mission — the trophy pops at the end, automatically. [1][5]
3. Free roam stays open after the credits, so nothing is locked behind the ending. [1][25]
4. After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist is live. [1][10]
5. The platinum is one trophy away after this one only if the other 53 are done. [1][5]

intro.text: The gold for finishing the story — it pops when the final mission ends.
The guides do not pin the final mission to one chapter cleanly, so this guide names no chapter for it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Play the story through to its final mission.

The platinum is one trophy away after this one only if the other 53 are done.

tips.text: Keep a save from before the final mission — one of the ten chapter-boundary saves this guide recommends.

trophies.guide:
1. Finish the story first; the checklist opens after the credits, though earlier progress already counts. [1][10]
2. Work the partial lines: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations. [1][10]
3. Work the full lines: all robberies, underwater discoveries, 42 shooting golds, all 14 drone locations, all 15 Target Decks, all 8 bank jobs, all 39 gang operations. [1][10]
4. Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything is doable in free roam. [1][25]
5. Track every line in this guide's 100% Ledger tab, with live counters. [1][36]

intro.text: The hardest trophy: the 100% checklist, which opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
The name is generous — the checklist is closer to 60% true completion, because most lines are partial.

trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Finish the story first; the checklist opens after the credits, though earlier progress already counts.
Work the partial lines: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations.
Work the full lines: all robberies, underwater discoveries, 42 shooting golds, all 14 drone locations, all 15 Target Decks, all 8 bank jobs, all 39 gang operations.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything is doable in free roam.
Track every line in this guide's 100% Ledger tab, with live counters.

tips.text: Budget about 100 hours for this step alone — it is the longest single trophy.

trophies.guide:
1. Open the map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots — every stunt is named there. [1][15]
2. Do any 250 stunts: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps. [1][15]
3. Under the Bridges are the quickest — fly or drive under the marked bridges. [1][15]
4. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and by region. [1][15]
5. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing #14. [1][10]

intro.text: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count — mix the four kinds freely.
Under the Bridges are the quickest; the map lists stunt spots by name.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Open the map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots — every stunt is named there.
Do any 250 stunts: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps.
Under the Bridges are the quickest — fly or drive under the marked bridges.
Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and by region.
The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing #14.

tips.text: Start stunts during the story — they feed both this trophy and the 100% list.

trophies.description: Try each of 9 activity types once.
trophies.guide:
1. Open Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — the tracker counts 9 types. [1][29]
2. Try each once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt. [1][29]
3. Fishing opens with Cal's chain after 'Feng Shui'; hunting with Bret's chain after 'Coffee Break'. [1][30]
4. Races and drone races count as the race type; any stunt counts as the stunt type. [1][17]
5. The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried — no need to win or finish anything. [1][2]

intro.text: Nine activity types, one try each — the tracker under Progress, then Activities, counts them.
Most come automatically from the story and from unfogging the map.

trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Open Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — the tracker counts 9 types.
Try each once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt.
Fishing opens with Cal's chain after 'Feng Shui'; hunting with Bret's chain after 'Coffee Break'.
Races and drone races count as the race type; any stunt counts as the stunt type.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried — no need to win or finish anything.

tips.text: Do the odd ones early — pool and basketball are easy to forget.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Find the 12 Shooting Range locations across Leonida. [1][14]
2. Earn gold in every challenge at each range — 42 golds in total. [1][14]
3. Shooting Range challenges also raise Combat Focus, which helps trophy #36. [1][14]
4. Replay a challenge until the gold lands; silver and bronze do not count. [1][2]
5. All 42 golds are also needed for the 100% checklist. [1][10]

intro.text: Twelve Shooting Range locations, 42 gold medals in total — every challenge at every range.
Gold is per challenge, not per range: each range holds several.

trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Find the 12 Shooting Range locations across Leonida.
Earn gold in every challenge at each range — 42 golds in total.
Shooting Range challenges also raise Combat Focus, which helps trophy #36.
Replay a challenge until the gold lands; silver and bronze do not count.
All 42 golds are also needed for the 100% checklist.

tips.text: Use a steady weapon and take the stationary targets first.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
1. Find the 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations across Leonida. [1][17]
2. Win one race at each location — 14 wins in total. [1][17]
3. Three races run at most locations; any one win counts. [1][17]
4. All 14 locations are also needed for the 100% checklist. [1][10]
5. Practice the course once before racing it for real. [1][17]

intro.text: Fourteen drone-race locations, 42 races in total — win one at each location.
One win per location is enough; you do not need all 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations across Leonida.
Win one race at each location — 14 wins in total.
Three races run at most locations; any one win counts.
All 14 locations are also needed for the 100% checklist.
Practice the course once before racing it for real.

tips.text: Drone races are short — clear a location in minutes once you know the course.

trophies.guide:
1. Find the 40 unique race locations across Leonida. [1][18]
2. Win a race at 20 different locations. [1][18]
3. Track which locations you have won at — repeat wins at the same spot do not count. [1][18]
4. Unique Races also feed the 100% list through the race lines. [1][10]
5. Use a fast car you trust; the course matters more than the car. [1][31]

intro.text: Twenty wins at twenty different race locations — forty unique locations exist in total.
Any race type counts; the win must be at a location you have not won at before.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Find the 40 unique race locations across Leonida.
Win a race at 20 different locations.
Track which locations you have won at — repeat wins at the same spot do not count.
Unique Races also feed the 100% list through the race lines.
Use a fast car you trust; the course matters more than the car.

tips.text: Races are quickest after the story, when the whole map is open.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
1. Play the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)'. [1][30]
2. Wait for Cal's text with a fishing location — a purple map icon marks it. [1][30]
3. Follow Cal's fishing questline to the challenge. [1][28]
4. Beat Cal in the fishing challenge. [1][30]
5. It stays available after the story, so there is no rush. [1][2]

intro.text: Cal's fishing chain starts after the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)' — he texts a fishing location.
Follow his questline to the fishing challenge and beat him.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Play the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)'.
Wait for Cal's text with a fishing location — a purple map icon marks it.
Follow Cal's fishing questline to the challenge.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.
It stays available after the story, so there is no rush.

tips.text: Fishing also counts toward the 9 activity types for trophy #16.

trophies.guide:
1. Find an arcade game: the first three are on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is at arcade machines in the world. [1][2]
2. Pick one: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. [1][2]
3. Finish all its levels once. [1][2]
4. The TV games are temporarily unavailable in some story sections — they return after the story. [1][2]
5. The trophy pops when the last level ends. [1][5]

intro.text: Four arcade games exist; complete any one of them.
'Complete' means finish all its levels once — no need to beat every challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Find an arcade game: the first three are on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is at arcade machines in the world.
Pick one: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
Finish all its levels once.
The TV games are temporarily unavailable in some story sections — they return after the story.
The trophy pops when the last level ends.

tips.text: The TV at home is the easiest place to start — no travel needed.

trophies.guide:
1. Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 — Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. [1][28]
2. Complete 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (Parts 1–3). [1][28]
3. Complete 'Pay the Cellerica Fee' and 'Peach!' (the Cellerica Initiation). [1][28]

Five quests, from the Cellerichain climb to the warehouse meet.

tips.text: Lucia-only chains need Lucia active — switch characters when the call comes.

trophies.guide:

Seven shipwrecks in total — dive for the treasures he marks.

tips.text: Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.guide:
1. Complete the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break'. [1][28]
2. Head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County when the chain is marked. [1][28]
3. Complete 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist Smash Grab' and 'Mall Rats'. [1][28]

Five quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete Kirk's strand: the Skunk Ape searches and the tree effigies. [1][13]
2. Complete Kyle's strand: McKittrick Farm, the chemicals and the check-in. [1][13]
3. Complete Yago's strand: the street races and the brother quests. [1][13]
4. Complete Pilot Pete's strand: 'The Last Mile' and the package deliveries. [1][13]
5. Start every stranger chain when it appears — more strangers are yet to be discovered, and the count is disputed. [1][2]

intro.text: Eight stranger strands count — but only certain questlines qualify, and no guide lists all eight.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count as strangers.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Complete Kirk's strand: the Skunk Ape searches and the tree effigies.
Complete Kyle's strand: McKittrick Farm, the chemicals and the check-in.
Complete Yago's strand: the street races and the brother quests.
Complete Pilot Pete's strand: 'The Last Mile' and the package deliveries.
Start every stranger chain when it appears — more strangers are yet to be discovered, and the count is disputed.

tips.text: Track it with the trophy list's tracker — it counts the strands for you.

trophies.guide:
1. Complete the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'. [1][28]
2. Randy's wish list appears under Map, then Robberies (money-bag icon), then Randy's Wish List. [1][28]
3. Find the 16 sports cars — often parked or driving in east Vice City, Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. [1][28]
4. Scan a car with WAiNK to check it is on the list, then deliver it in good condition for more pay. [1][28]
5. The green 'RK' icon in west Vice City marks Randy; deliveries stay doable after the story. [1][2]

intro.text: Randy's chain starts after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)'.
That mission unlocks the Key Cloner — the tool for breaking into high-end sports cars.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'.
Randy's wish list appears under Map, then Robberies (money-bag icon), then Randy's Wish List.
Find the 16 sports cars — often parked or driving in east Vice City, Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Scan a car with WAiNK to check it is on the list, then deliver it in good condition for more pay.

trophies.guide:

trophies.description: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner.

3. Escape in a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic. [1][2]
4. Easiest: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on train tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. [1][2]
5. The trophy pops after leaving the red 'heat' wanted zone, not the blue-red flashing search area. [1][2]

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:

2. Line up 5 enemies — best at Gang Operations — and defeat them quickly without missing. [1][2]
3. Use an assault rifle (the Duke 556) — more accurate than pistols or SMGs. [1][2]

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
1. Go to Vice City International Airport. [1][2]
2. Drive through a fence around the airfield to the departure terminals E3/E4. [1][2]
3. Take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane — or enter on foot through the terminal. [1][2]
4. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off. [1][2]
5. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy pops then. [1][2]

intro.text: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — not the planes on the airfield.

trophies.guide:
1. Take a plane and fly over every black-fog area until the map is visible. [1][25]

trophies.description: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
trophies.guide:
1. Turn on notifications: Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On — a small demon face appears on the right when an action counts. [1][24]

4. If it has not popped by the end of 100%, farm it by running over civilians or cops with a car. [1][24]
5. Check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. [1][24]

2. Look for a blinking car at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. [1][2]
3. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods — you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. [1][2]

5. Talk to her, offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and it pops. [1][2]

Look for a blinking car at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back.
Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods — you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky.
Approach it; the UFO drops an abducted woman.
Talk to her, offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and it pops.

tips.text: Solo only — the encounter needs one character alone.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills. [1][32]
2. Rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. [1][32]
3. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, unlocked after Chapter 4 'That's Where The Money Is…'. [1][20]
4. Launder the bills as you rob them — two vaults cover the $250,000. [1][20]
5. Track the total under Progress. [1][2]

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
